nom: Kopari Beauty Nourishing Hydro-Lipid Barrier Serum

avis.texte: Smell is AWFUL, and made my face breakout. Not sure what is in it that did not agree with me but the smell alone almost made me stop using it, and I do not have sensitive skin.

This is the best serum I have ever used for my normal/dry skin. This serum melts into the skin and provides instant moisture, without feeling greasy or leaving behind a residue. I have not found a dupe that gives me the same result and soft glow. I will continue to rebuy this serum when I run out.
This is a great serum. However, please upgrade the bottle! For this price, the letters shouldn't come off my hand, and the pump stopped working with more than half of the product left.
I love this product so much. It is so radiant and soft. It is now a part of my daily routine. A must try!
I LOVE this it makes my face glow and keeps it hydrated all day. My skin feels and looks so healthy, I will never be without Nourishing Hydro - Lipid Barrier Serum.

avis.titre: Wish it was a bigger bottle!
avis.texte: Love this serum. I use on my hands where excema has broken down my skin barrier. Love it!
Only problem is pump. It squirts out everywhere!! Have pump less powerful so we can adjust how much comes out!!
Absolutely love this product! It smells wonderful and is so hydrating. My only complaint is that there is very little product for the price. doesn't last long at all.

I was pleasantly surprised by this serum. I love the Kopari body care and sunscreens, but I don't reach for Kopari skincare often. This product is changing that for me.it's a unique formula. I would describe this as hybrid serum/light balm. It has milky texture, and leaves the skin looking dewy and plump. I find that I don't need to use anything else after applying it. As it is a bit heavier, I love it post-shower after a day in the sun, or at bedtime. Definitely a staple for me now!

This product was the one in my purchase I had the most excited for. It slid over my skin and was beautiful the moment it was on. Then I quickly realized, it left a sticky sort of tacky feel as it never did actually soak into my skin. The entire evening, my face was a sticky trap for anything nearby. It was so bad I got up at 2am to wash it from my face. Such a let down. Another item in return status.
I have always loved everything Kopari. I purchased this thinking it would be like a milky serum to nourish my skin. I have found it to be sticky and doesn't blend across my face well.

avis.titre: Not loving how this ‚ my face
avis.texte: I have always loved everything Kopari! This product, however, I am not in love with. I purchased this thinking it would be a milky serum to nourish my skin. It starts out feeling that way, but then feels sticky and doesn't seem to spread easily. I am just a bit disappointed in its final feel on my skin. I'll have to see if it actually makes a difference on my skin
This is the best hyaluronic serum I've used! Most serums dry out my skin over night but I could still feel the moisturizing in the morning. This is the best!
This serum actually has some pearlescent shine and moisturizes very well! Not like other serums that leave your skin feeling dried.

I tried this out because the esthetician at ulta claimed it was gentle, unscented, and safe for sensitive skin. It's certainly scented and has several pore clogging ingredients. After using daily in the morning for 1 week, i can say it made my skin glow for hours and was a nice base for makeup. However since then I've broken out and i will not continue to use.

**I purchased this with my own money** I have dry skin so I am always on the hunt for products that support the barrier and hydrate, and this does both! This really is a great hydrating & repair serum. I do not have any irritation or redness from this, which is a huge plus for me, just smooth skin. I personally feel the difference in my skin when I remove my makeup and skincare at the end of the day and when I wake up. My skin feels baby-soft, so that indicates that it's working deeper in the skin, not just the surface. My only complaint is that it has a potent scent which smells like synthetic coconut water/milk. It's pretty strong, so those sensitive to fragrance may experience irritation. For me, for my dry skin, I love this serum!

Quite honestly wasn't sure how this would go. I love everything else i use from you guys, my facial gal said, "build your barrier" lord am I, even my husband said, your look glassy and moisturized. Like obviously. Topped it with the vitamin c moisturizer! Will be buying again!

avis.titre: Restored my skin barrier after a severe chemical burn
avis.texte: I had a terrible reaction to hydroquinone and my skin was practically peeled off. The put the serum as serum on at night and mixed it in with my moisturizer in the morning. This practically saved my skin barrier all by itself. To note: I have oily/acne skin and didn't break me out at all. Keep in mind it makes you super dewy!
So good I wish I got 2 during the sale. It smells fruity and feels amazing on the skin. Instantly makes your skin look and feel glowing and healthy.

I am absolutely obsessed with this serum. The texture is more like a lightweight lotion, it smells amazing, and it absorbs into the skin so quickly. It leaves my skin feeling deeply moisturized with the most beautiful glow. I can't stop using it — I highly, highly recommend!
